import java.util.*;

public class Test {
    int rows, cols;
    long[][] comb = new long[64][64];
    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
    char[] moves;
    Map<Long, Long> memo = new TreeMap<>();

    void buildComb() {
        int n = 2 * (rows + cols);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = j == 0 ? 1 : (i == 0 ? 0 : comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }
    }

    void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - comb[v1][rows] * comb[v2][rows] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            if (diff < best) best = diff;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 > 0) {
            long dy = (comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows]) * comb[v2][rows];
            dfs(x, y + dy, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0) {
            long dx = comb[v1][rows] * (comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows]);
            dfs(x + dx, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long count(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        Long cached = memo.get(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        long res = 0L;
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (diff - comb[v1][rows] * comb[v2][rows] > best) {
            memo.put(key, res);
            return res;
        }
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) return 1L;
        char ch = moves[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (v1 > 0 && ch != 'B') {
            long dy = (comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows]) * comb[v2][rows];
            res += count(x, y + dy, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0 && ch != 'A') {
            long dx = comb[v1][rows] * (comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows]);
            res += count(x + dx, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memo.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

    void run() {
        rows = in.nextInt();
        cols = in.nextInt();
        in.nextLine();
        moves = in.nextLine().toCharArray();
        buildComb();
        int v1 = rows + cols, v2 = rows + cols;
        long x = 0, y = 0;
        while (v1 > 0 && v2 > 0) {
            if (x > y) {
                long dy = (comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows]) * comb[v2][rows];
                y += dy;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long dx = comb[v1][rows] * (comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows]);
                x += dx;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = Math.abs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
        System.out.println(count(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Test().run();
    }
}
